[[File:Adamant longsword detail.png|left|120px]]
The '''adamant longsword''' is a [[longsword]] that is stronger than the [[Mithril longsword]], but weaker than the [[Rune longsword]]. Like all other [[adamant weapons]], it requires 30 [[Attack]] to wield. Players can make an adamant longsword with 76 [[Smithing]] using 2 [[adamantite bar]]s, granting 125 experience. It can be bought from the [[Varrock Swordshop]] for 3,200 coins.
